title: Use explicit depth attachment or disable depth test in mesh dynamic rendering
purpose: Avoid using depth test with VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED depth attachment in VkPipelineRenderingCreateInfo.

steps.detail: Add transient depth image (D32 or D24S8) for dynamic rendering and set renderingInfo.depthAttachmentFormat accordingly; provide image, view, layout transitions, and include VkRenderingAttachmentInfo in vkCmdBeginRendering for mesh path.
If depth not desired, set depthTestEnable=FALSE for both mesh pipelines and point-sprite pipeline while leaving depthAttachmentFormat undefined.
Choose option_b initially (disable depth) to unblock crashes, then optionally implement option_a later.
Log selected option at startup: '[CR 1039] Mesh depth mode: Disabled|Attachment(D32)'.

acceptance: No freeze when mesh renders with dynamic rendering
Validation shows no warnings about depth attachment format
